A Medicaid waiver pays for long-term support at home or in the community. In Virginia these are the DD waivers, and the waitlist runs years. Where is {name} on it? Who manages the paperwork and the yearly updates?

SSI is a monthly check for people with disabilities and limited income. SSDI is based on a parent's work record. Add Medicaid, Medicare, and any waiver programs. Name what {name} gets, and roughly since when.
e.g., SSI since age 18; Virginia Medicaid; on the DD waiver waitlist since 2021

The county denied his waiver slot in 2021. We appealed with a letter from his neurologist and won in four months — the phrase that mattered was "institutional level of care." Get every denial in writing. Never accept a no by phone.
